headline: Reagan shows what inflation did to a *1960 dollar*
quote: Thirty-six cents. That's what this 1960 dollar is worth today.
title: Reagan shows what inflation did to the dollar (1981)
caption: February 5, 1981: President Reagan holds up a dollar and 36 cents to show how much buying power the dollar lost between 1960 and 1980.
context: Since 1960, prices have risen *{cpi:1960-01}*. That dollar is now worth about *{cpic:1960-01}*.
comment: What did a dollar buy when you were a kid? 👇
